description: Expected results for the official WRF idealized case test/em_quarter_ss (WRF 4.7.1, commit f15568cc): 3D supercell thunderstorm (Weisman-Klemp sounding, quarter-circle shear), 41x41x40 mass points, dx 2 km, dt 12 s, 60 min, Kessler microphysics, no radiation/PBL/surface. WRF ships NO reference output for this case: all values are OWN-RUN values (regression values), not official reference results.
